## Goal

The board view: live board state, columns and cards, adding cards and
columns, deleting columns, members and invites.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `frontend/src/board/useBoard.ts`: load, live updates, the version rule, reload after a change
- `frontend/src/board/BoardView.tsx`, `frontend/src/board/BoardView.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/App.tsx` (route `board` -> `BoardView`), `App.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/styles.css`

### Steps

1. `useBoard(boardId)`: `board` state shown through `newerBoard` (ticket 003) for both `api.getBoard` results and `board` events from `useLive().onEvent` whose `board.id === boardId`; `subscribe(boardId)` on mount and `subscribe(null)` on unmount; `notFound` when the load fails with `ApiError` code `not_found`; `run(change: () => Promise<unknown>)` awaits the change and then reloads with `getBoard`, rethrowing the change's error for the caller to show.
2. `BoardView({boardId})`: `Board not found` + `Back to boards` link (`href="#/"`) on 404; `Loading…` before the first board; then the board name as `<h2>`, the back link, the members' display names, and an invite form (input labelled `Invite by username`, button `Invite`): `ApiError` `not_found` -> `No user with that username` in an alert, other `ApiError`s their message.
3. Columns in `position` order, each a `<section aria-label={column.name}>` with an `<h3>`, its cards in `position` order as `<li>` showing the title and the assignee's display name (via `memberName`), an `Add card` form (input labelled `New card in <column name>`, button `Add`, cleared on success), and a `Delete column <name>` button whose 409 shows `column has cards` in an alert.
4. An `Add column` form: input labelled `Column name`, button `Add column`; validation errors in an alert.
5. Render each card's title as a `<button>` (ticket 007 opens the editor from it) and leave a `CardActions` slot: render nothing for now.
6. Run `make verify` and make it pass.

### Tests to add

- `BoardView.test.tsx` (`stubFetch` + `installFakeWebSocket`, a `LiveProvider` wrapper): renders columns as named regions with cards in position order even when the JSON lists them out of order; subscribes on mount (the fake socket's `sent` holds the frame) and forgets the subscription on unmount (a later reconnect sends no frame); a `board` event with a higher version replaces the view, a lower one is ignored, another board's is ignored; a REST reload older than an event already shown does not roll it back; add card posts and reloads; add column; delete non-empty column shows `column has cards`; invite 404 shows `No user with that username`; 404 board shows `Board not found`.
- `App.test.tsx`: `#/boards/3` renders the board's heading.
